description: Stage 4 extraction labels, written by hand before any extraction run and frozen: change the prompt against these, never these against a run. Each passage lists every named entity a correct extraction holds (name as the passage writes it, and its type) and every dependency the passage itself states, in its direction. `not_relations` are pairs a careless extraction would add — both mentioned, the reverse direction, or a comparison — and must not be adopted. Entities match on the normalized name; type agreement is reported apart. Precision and recall of entities, of proposed dependencies and of adopted ones are measured separately.

passages.heading: Search > Ranking
passages.text: The search daemon `search/daemon.py` ranks chunks two ways: BM25 over English words and Hangul bigrams, and cosine similarity over a local `multilingual-e5-small` model, merged by reciprocal rank.

passages.heading: Search > Port
passages.text: The daemon listens on port 8791, next to the chat's 8787 and the mirror's 9090. `WIKI_SEARCH=off` makes every caller skip it and fall back to BM25 in its own process.

passages.heading: Jev > Controller
passages.text: `search/controller.py` never imports `decision`; the caller `main/knowledge.py` hands it `decision.evaluate` as an argument. `main/knowledge.py` imports `translate` and `decision` and composes them.

passages.heading: Runtime > Settings
passages.text: `tool/common/settings.py` is the only code that reads `.env`; `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` and `WIKI_JEV_MODE` are read from it on every request, so a changed key reaches a running server.

passages.heading: Translate > Engine
passages.text: `translate.english()` sends Korean text to `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` and caches the outcome; English text is never sent. A failed translation is `unavailable`, not a cached success.

passages.heading: Attention Is All You Need > Abstract
passages.text: We propose the Transformer, a model architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task show it to be superior in quality.

passages.heading: 결정 > 지도
passages.text: 결정. 지도는 `repo_graph.picture()` 가 그린다. 이 함수는 인덱스를 만들지 않고 `search.projection()` 을 읽기만 한다.

passages.heading: Notes
passages.text: Keep the explanation short and check it before sending.
